## Checklist

All pull requests:

- [ ] The text is in ASD-STE100.
- [ ] No quest id changed.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/pytest` passes.

A pull request that adds or changes a lab (delete this part if not):

- [ ] The lab states an end state and gives no command to copy.
- [ ] The lab uses GA APIs only.
- [ ] Each check has a `why` that does not give the fix.
- [ ] The lab has a machine solution in `tests/e2e/solutions/`.
- [ ] `.venv/bin/pytest -m e2e` passes on a real minikube.
- [ ] The entry of the lab in `docs/designs/course-expansion.md` is up to date.

See the rules in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/spillows/KubeTrail/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#rules).
